# @uptimizr/aframe

> The A-Frame (WebXR) connector for Uptimizr. A thin A-Frame layer over `@uptimizr/three`: a
> declarative `<a-scene uptimizr="...">` component hands A-Frame's three.js scene/camera/renderer
> to the three connector. `three` is a peer dependency; A-Frame itself is supplied by the host
> page. Adds WebXR controller/gaze capture on the existing source-neutral events.

## Docs

- [Package reference](./README.md): component usage, the WebXR mapping table, the full attribute schema, replay, package boundary.
- [Agent guide](./AGENTS.md): rules and canonical usage for AI agents.
- [Connector guide](https://uptimizr.com/docs/connectors/aframe/): the docs-site walkthrough.
- [three connector](../sdk-three/README.md): the capture engine and the full option surface.
- [Integration & API reference](https://github.com/RaananW/Uptimizr/blob/main/docs/integration.md): track and query the data.
- [Architecture Decision Records](https://github.com/RaananW/Uptimizr/tree/main/docs/adr): privacy model (0003), scene ids (0010), input-source-agnostic events (0011), sampling & fidelity (0012), coordinate frame & connector provenance (0018), AR/VR spatial analytics (0048).

## Key exports

- Importing the package registers the `uptimizr` component against the global `AFRAME` (side effect).
- `registerUptimizrComponent(aframe?)` / `createUptimizrComponent(libraryVersion?)` — explicit registration.
- `COMPONENT_NAME`, `UPTIMIZR_SCHEMA` — the attribute name and the declared component schema.
- `buildTrackOptions(data)` — maps the component schema onto three's `TrackSceneOptions`.
- `xrCollector(options)` — WebXR controller/gaze capture, re-exported from `@uptimizr/three`.
- Re-exported option types: `TrackSceneOptions`, `ThreeCaptureOptions`, `XrCollectorOptions`, `XrCaptureOptions`, `MeshVisibilityOptions`, `HoverDwellOptions`, `ResourceSampleOptions`.
